headline: Stealth's ox-alpha debuts at #1 with 14.3% share
summary: A brand-new entrant from stealth just claimed the top spot on OpenRouter, capturing 14.3% of token share and pushing DeepSeek's v4-flash down to rank 2. The move marks the first time a model has hit #1 in this dataset. Meanwhile, Xiaomi's mimo-v2.5 continues its week-long climb, now sitting at #3 with 12.4% share—up 8.4 percentage points over seven days.
highlights: stealth/ox-alpha enters at rank 1 with 14.3% token share—first-time #1 record
DeepSeek drops to #2 (13.3%), down 1.7 points in one day
Xiaomi's mimo-v2.5 holds rank 3 at 12.4%, up 8.4 points in 7 days
DeepSeek provider share fell 3.6 points overnight but still leads at 22.1%
Stealth provider now at 14.3% share, instantly third-largest by volume
